## Summary

## Validation

- [ ] `yarn check:ui`
- [ ] `yarn format:check`
- [ ] `yarn typecheck`
- [ ] `yarn test`
- [ ] Relevant builds and Storybook

## Design-system review

- [ ] I identified the owning visual domain: product, reader, authored data, or rendering boundary.
- [ ] I reused an established contract or documented why a new one is needed.
- [ ] Loading, empty, partial, error, disabled, focus, narrow, and reduced-motion states are covered where relevant.
- [ ] Product language is local-first and avoids unsupported cloud/account terminology.
- [ ] Shared component changes include stable Storybook stories.
- [ ] New tokens or intentional exceptions are documented.
